soundness_flags.label: def:calibration-residual-envelope; def:bias-aware-interval; thm:fixed-class-honesty
soundness_flags.one_line: The interval is not an unambiguous statistic: the multiplier process defining E-hat and the foldwise standard-error summands, covariance treatment, and boundary linear term defining se-hat are only described informally, so I_{h,J} cannot yet be evaluated or its claimed studentization checked.

accepted_scope_caveats.label: thm:sharp-frontier
accepted_scope_caveats.caveat: The frontier is conditional on the one-dimensional factorized polynomial-boundary class, bounded outcomes, known randomized propensity, and fixed regularity indices.
accepted_scope_caveats.bound_claim: Any sharp-frontier claim is only over this stated one-dimensional transport class, not multivariate boundary geometries or observational treatment assignment.

accepted_scope_caveats.label: thm:fixed-class-honesty and oeq:self-similar-adaptation
accepted_scope_caveats.caveat: Fixed-class inference prespecifies (a,s,t,M); adaptation is restricted to the stated self-similar subclass and remains an open-ended question.
accepted_scope_caveats.bound_claim: The accepted inference scope is fixed-class honesty only; no unrestricted adaptive interval is claimed.
